summary: Snapchat Marketing API integration tested end-to-end (backend + frontend). All 19 Snapchat backend tests pass + 23 regression tests pass (42/42). Frontend Snapchat UI works: section renders, fields persist, status shows correctly, connect button disabled when empty, daily-snap-fetch-btn rendered & disabled without real connection. CRITICAL BUG FOUND: logout does NOT actually log the user out — backend /api/auth/logout sends Set-Cookie with SameSite=lax while original login cookies were SameSite=None; Secure, so browsers don't clear them. After frontend window.location.replace('/login'), the cookie auto-restores session and the user lands back on dashboard. Recharts width(-1) warnings: not observed in console during nav across pages.

critical.issue: clear_auth_cookies() uses response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/') without secure=True/samesite='none'. Login cookies were set with SameSite=None;Secure → deletion Set-Cookie has SameSite=lax → browser does NOT clear the original cookie → /api/auth/me still returns the user. Confirmed via curl: after POST /api/auth/logout 200, GET /api/auth/me still returns 200 with the user. This is the ROOT CAUSE of the logout race the frontend window.location.replace fix was meant to mitigate. Fix: update /app/backend/auth.py clear_auth_cookies to pass secure=True, samesite='none', path='/' (and httponly=True) so the deletion cookie matches the original attributes.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking logout-btn calls /api/auth/logout (200) and window.location.replace('/login'), but because backend does not actually invalidate the cookie (see backend critical), the new /login page is immediately re-authenticated via cookie and redirects back to dashboard. Playwright test stuck at /daily-costs → after navigate to /login the page rendered dashboard again. The fix must be on backend.

action_items: BACKEND CRITICAL: In /app/backend/auth.py clear_auth_cookies(), call response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/', secure=True, samesite='none', httponly=True) and same for refresh_token. Without this, logout is effectively a no-op for cookie sessions and the new window.location.replace('/login') workaround is hidden by auto re-auth via /me.
(Optional) Add server-side refresh_token revocation/blacklist so even leaked tokens are invalidated.
(Optional) After backend fix, verify Playwright logout flow ends on /login and does not auto-redirect to /.

rca of the issue: Logout cookie not cleared. Login path (auth.py set_auth_cookies) sets access_token with httponly=True, secure=True, samesite='none', path='/'. Logout path (clear_auth_cookies) calls response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/') with no other attributes; Starlette emits Set-Cookie with default SameSite=lax and no Secure flag. Modern browsers treat the deletion cookie as a different cookie (because SameSite/Secure differ) and DO NOT remove the original. Verified by curl: POST /api/auth/logout 200 → cookie jar still contains access_token → subsequent GET /api/auth/me returns the user. Mitigation: pass matching attributes to delete_cookie: response.delete_cookie('access_token', path='/', secure=True, samesite='none', httponly=True) and same for refresh_token.
